site.name: TCK
site.tagline: Global Business. Local Precision. Zero Friction.

footer.description: Independent cross-border consultancy connecting European and Korean businesses across sourcing, market entry, and OEM coordination.

hero.sub: TCK helps international companies enter, source, coordinate, and operate between Korea and Europe — with hands-on local execution, supplier expertise, and clear cross-border communication.

services.title: Practical support across the full cross-border lifecycle
services.sub: From first sourcing inquiry to long-term operations — we handle the work that international teams cannot do efficiently from abroad.

sourcing.title: Source Directly from Qualified Suppliers
sourcing.body: Identify, qualify, and negotiate with verified European and Korean suppliers — backed by factory visits, audits, and reference checks.

marketEntry.title: Enter Korea Without Regulatory Delays
marketEntry.body: Import procedures, certification pathways, labelling requirements, and partner introductions — handled with local market knowledge.

communication.title: Bridge Language, Culture, and Execution
communication.body: On-the-ground representation and trilingual support in German, English, and Korean — for negotiation, coordination, and follow-through.

supplements.title: Launch German-Quality Supplements in Korea
supplements.body: End-to-end Made-in-Germany supplement coordination: formulation, contract manufacturing, Korean import, and KFDA pathway.

qc.title: Protect Your Shipment Before It Leaves the Factory
qc.body: Pre-shipment inspections, factory audits, and ongoing QC monitoring — so issues are caught at origin, not in customs.

industrial.title: Keep Industrial Projects Moving On-Site
industrial.body: On-site project coordination, technical documentation, and supplier liaison for machinery and equipment programmes in Korea.

specialization.title: Made-in-Germany Health Supplement Solutions
specialization.sub: We coordinate end-to-end supplement programmes for brands that demand the credibility of German manufacturing and the speed of a single accountable partner.

bullets.oem: OEM coordination with audited German contract manufacturers
bullets.ingredients: Ingredient sourcing — vetted European raw material suppliers
bullets.import: Korea import support: KFDA pathway, labelling, customs
bullets.regulatory: Regulatory alignment between EU and Korean frameworks

whyTck.title: Why companies choose TCK
whyTck.sub: Not a large firm with a local desk. A specialist practice that lives and operates in Korea.

presence.title: We are in Korea, not advising from a distance
presence.body: On-the-ground presence means faster responses, local problems handled locally, and no information lost in transit.

fluency.title: European standards combined with Korean market fluency
fluency.body: We bridge the gap that stalls most cross-border projects — not just in language, but in business expectations and working style.

execution.title: We coordinate execution, not just strategy
execution.body: We don't hand over a framework and leave. We follow through, coordinate the details, and stay accountable until the work is done.

endToEnd.title: Suppliers, documents, inspections — one engagement
endToEnd.body: Everything managed as a connected workflow — no gaps between advisors, no broken handoffs, no parallel confusion.

prevention.title: Costly mistakes caught before they happen
prevention.body: Most cross-border errors are preventable. We identify them early because we've navigated the same situations many times before.

inquiry.title: 1. Inquiry
inquiry.body: Share the brief — products, volumes, timelines, target market. We respond within two working days.

evaluation.title: 2. Evaluation
evaluation.body: Feasibility, supplier shortlist, regulatory pathway, and a fixed-fee scope of work.

execution.title: 3. Execution
execution.body: Hands-on coordination from contract to delivery — with weekly status reports in your language.

about.title: A German consultant based in Korea since 2008, solving the practical problems that happen between strategy and execution.
about.body: TCK is led by Markus Rathenow — a German cross-border consultant with more than 15 years in Korea and over a decade in international trade. His approach is direct: fewer engagements, deeper involvement, and the kind of trilingual fluency that gets contracts negotiated once — not three times.

highlights.handson: Hands-on involvement from brief to delivery

finalCta.title: Ready to reduce the friction between Korea and Europe?
finalCta.sub: Tell us what you are sourcing, launching, or coordinating. TCK will help you identify the practical next steps.

hero.title: Cross-border services for European and Korean companies
hero.sub: Seven focused practices, all delivered directly by experienced cross-border specialists — never sub-contracted to a black box.

sourcing.title: Product Sourcing & Supply Chain
sourcing.overview: Identify and qualify European and Korean suppliers for finished goods, ingredients, and industrial components. We work hands-on, visit factories, and negotiate terms that hold up under real production pressure.
items: Factory visits, audits, and reference checks
sourcing.benefits: Lower supplier risk, predictable lead times, and pricing that reflects what the market actually pays.

marketEntry.title: Market Entry & Import Consulting
marketEntry.overview: Plan and execute a structured market entry into Korea — from regulatory pathway to first shipment to channel introductions. Designed for European brands serious about long-term presence.
items: Import duty, HS code, and regulatory analysis
marketEntry.benefits: A clear, sequenced plan instead of a regulatory surprise three months in.

communication.title: Business Communication & Representation
communication.overview: Day-to-day cross-border communication, in your time zone and your language. We act as your local extension — not a translation service.
items: Negotiation support in German, English, Korean
Trade show and B2B event representation
communication.benefits: Faster decisions, fewer misunderstandings, and a partner accountable for outcomes.

supplements.title: Health Supplement Solutions
supplements.overview: End-to-end coordination of Made-in-Germany supplement programmes — from formulation through Korean retail. The most common request we receive, and our deepest specialization.
items: Formulation briefs and contract manufacturer matching
Korea import, KFDA submission, and labelling
supplements.benefits: A credible Made-in-Germany product, ready for the Korean shelf, without juggling five vendors.

technical.title: Technical & On-Site Support
technical.overview: Hands-on technical coordination for projects that need someone physically present — installation, commissioning, training, or troubleshooting.
technical.benefits: A reliable on-the-ground presence without flying your engineers in for every issue.

qc.title: Inspection & Quality Control
qc.overview: Independent pre-shipment inspections, factory audits, and recurring QC oversight — protecting your brand and your buyers from preventable issues.
qc.benefits: Issues caught before container, not in customs.

setup.title: Business Setup Support
setup.overview: Practical support for European companies establishing a presence in Korea — from initial registration to first hire.
setup.benefits: A working Korean entity in months, not quarters.

hero.title: Sector experience across the Korea-Europe corridor
hero.sub: Five industries where we have direct, repeated project experience.

supplements.title: Health Supplements
supplements.body1: Our deepest specialization. End-to-end Made-in-Germany OEM programmes — formulation, contract manufacturing, ingredient sourcing, Korean import, and KFDA pathway.
supplements.body2: Built on long-standing relationships with audited German manufacturers and Korean distributors who understand the supplement category.

food.title: Food & Beverage
food.body1: Sourcing of European specialty foods, frozen goods, and beverages for Korean importers and retailers, including HACCP-aligned suppliers.
food.body2: Pragmatic support on labelling, cold chain logistics, and category-specific Korean import procedures.

industrial.title: Industrial Equipment
industrial.body1: On-site coordination for industrial machinery and electronics programmes — installation support, technical documentation, and operator training in Korean.
industrial.body2: Long-running relationships with European OEMs and Korean integrators across laser, automation, and process equipment.

raw.title: Raw Materials
raw.body1: Cross-border sourcing of food-grade and industrial raw materials with strict QC, traceability, and consistent batch quality.
raw.body2: Audited suppliers, sample-and-trial workflows, and clear contracts that survive real-world tolerance issues.

cosmetics.title: Cosmetics
cosmetics.body1: European cosmetics brand support for the Korean market — registration, ingredient compliance, and channel introduction.
cosmetics.body2: Particular strength in clean-beauty and natural-cosmetics positioning, where regulatory and narrative alignment matter.

hero.title: Independent cross-border consulting, built in Korea
hero.sub: TCK exists because European and Korean businesses both deserve a partner who actually understands the other side — operationally, culturally, and commercially.

founder.title: Markus Rathenow, Founder & CEO
founder.body1: A German cross-border consultant with more than 15 years in Korea and over a decade in international trade. Before founding TCK, Markus worked across sourcing, OEM coordination, and quality control — first in Europe, then on the ground in Seoul.
founder.body2: His practice is direct: fewer projects, deeper involvement, and the kind of trilingual fluency (German · English · Korean) that lets a contract get negotiated once instead of three times.
founder.quote: Most cross-border problems are not regulatory — they are communication. Solve the communication and the rest follows.

y2008.label: Relocated to Korea; began full-time cross-border work.

y2012.label: Expanded scope: OEM and quality control programmes.

y2024.label: TCK formalized as an independent practice.

direct.title: Direct, not delegated
direct.body: You work with the principal who quoted the project — not a junior account manager.

trilingual.title: Trilingual by default
trilingual.body: German, English, and Korean used interchangeably so nothing is lost in translation.

honest.title: Honest scoping
honest.body: We decline projects that don't fit. Smaller scope, higher conviction, fixed fees.

longterm.title: Long-term relationships
longterm.body: Most clients return within twelve months. We work to be worth keeping.
